name: Eyes In The Night gives a grouped damage dealer its own passive, single-bite Shadow Bats that scale on and heal that ally (#3247)
contract: A Bloodmage tank with Eyes In The Night 801959 groups with a damage dealer. 801959 periodically recasts
Shadow Colony 806723, a raid area aura that gives grouped players within 20 yd a 40% chance (5 s internal
cooldown) to trigger Call of the Darkwing 801958 when they take direct damage. Only the ally attacks the
monster, so only the ally takes damage. The engine casts the proc-triggered Call from the aura's carrier
(AuraEffect::HandleProcTriggerSpellAuraProc: triggerCaster = aurApp->GetTarget()), so the bats belong to
the ally and the Bloodmage summons none. Each bat casts Bat Bite 802358 once and then stays passive, and
the bite adds 0.4 x spell power and 0.2 x attack power of the bat's owner to its base damage. Bat Bite's
unscaled damage at level 80 is 5 + 0.65 x (80 - 24), about 41; the ally carries a 10000 attack power
fixture bonus and the Bloodmage none, so a bite scaled on the ally deals about 2041 before armor, while a
bite scaled on the Bloodmage or left unscaled stays far below 500. The monster has enough health, and both
players enough health, that the fight lasts the whole 60 s window. The Bloodmage is held at 50% health and
the ally starts at 100%, so the threat redirect (ally below the Bloodmage's percentage) does not pull the
monster away from the ally during the window.
Each bite also casts Bat Bite's heal 802399 on the bat's owner for the bite's damage, so the ally receives one heal per bite whose average carries the same attack power bonus.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Bloodmage tank learns Eyes In The Night
SETUP: Eyes In The Night puts Shadow Colony on the grouped ally
Only the ally attacks; the aggressive monster fights back on the ally
The ally owns a Shadow Bat once Shadow Colony procs
Keep the fight running for more procs
SETUP: the monster is still alive
The ally cast Call of the Darkwing from Shadow Colony
The Bloodmage, never hit, cast no Call of the Darkwing
The Bloodmage owns no Shadow Bat
The ally never owns more than 10 Shadow Bats
DISCRIMINATING: each bat attacks at most once (a Call summons 1-2 bats)
DISCRIMINATING: an average bite carries the ally's attack power bonus
DISCRIMINATING: every bite healed the ally
DISCRIMINATING: an average heal carries the ally's attack power bonus
